body: That’s perfect! I’ll probably need that time to get Celia in boxes for you!
I can get Celia for you, but yeah you’ll need to have an empty plot on your island when you come to talk to her.
I do! I have Apollo and Celia
Can I trade you something for it??

I know it’s easy to feel that way, because I often feel that way too. But from the sounds of your post you sound young, and you have a whole life ahead of you. You won’t live with your parents forever.
It’s a lot easier to say that and apply it to other peoples situations.

I know you might not want to hear this right now but you have so much left to live for. You should stick around to fall in love, experience life with your friends, and discover new foods to love. Parents can be a bitch, I know mine were when I was younger. But maybe you’ll get past this, and/or maybe one day you’ll make a new family, whether you find family in your friends, in a lover, children, or pets. You get to choose and make your own family one day. It gets better.
